svg.title: Option A, separate apps: Azure network diagram
svg.desc: The browser loads the viewer from Static Web Apps, then reaches five container apps through a public IP and load balancer. The apps share a Container Apps environment in one subnet of a virtual network. Keycloak, annotation-store and messaging each use a database on one PostgreSQL Flexible Server in a second subnet. GitHub Actions deploys, and telemetry goes to Application Insights.
svg.text: external ingress on all five apps, TLS ends here
App to app, in the environment
